info.name: Get a list of Slack channels

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Return the page of results immediately after this cursor

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Return the page of results immediately before this cursor

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page

params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

items.docs:
Requires the Snyk Slack App to be set up for this org, will retrieve a list of channels the Snyk Slack App can access. Note that it is currently only possible to page forwards through this collection, no prev links will be generated and the ending_before parameter will not function.

#### Required permissions

- `Install Apps (org.app.install)`

info.name: Get Slack Channel name by Slack Channel ID.

params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

items.docs:
Requires the Snyk Slack App to be set up for this org. It will return the Slack channel name for the provided Slack channel ID.

#### Required permissions

- `Install Apps (org.app.install)`
